GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 132 (24 Dec 45) ESS/FI
(SCAPIN - 493)
APO 500
24 December 1945
MEMORANDUM FOR : Imperial Japanese Government
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo
SUBJECT : Supplemental Instructions Relating to the Liquidation of Heinrich Koppers, Tokyo Office
1. Reference is made to Memorandum for the Imperial Japanese Government, file AG 132 (30 Nov 45) ESS/FI, subject: "Application of Heinrich Koppers, Tokyo Office, for Release of Blocked Funds."
2. The reference Memorandum is hereby amended and the Imperial Japanese Government is directed to permit to be made, in addition to those heretofore authorized, such withdrawals from the blocked bank accounts of Heinrich Koppers, Tokyo Office as are necessary for the payment of taxes to the Japanese Government; salaries, bonuses and separation allowances of employees; legal and accounting expenses incurred in liquidating the firm; and settlements on contracts entered into prior to 20 September 1945.
3. An acknowledgement of the receipt of this Memorandum is directed.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
/s/ H. W. Allen
/t/ H. W. ALLEN,
Colonel, A.G.D.,
Asst. Adjutant General.
